name: Non-Immigrant Visitor Visa

requirements.blocker_text: A valid passport with at least 6 months' validity is required.
requirements.fix_path: Renew passport to have at least 6 months' validity remaining.

requirements.blocker_text: A return ticket to the port of origin is required.

evidence_required.document: Visa fee: EC$125 single entry (3mo) or EC$190 multiple entry (1yr)

outcome.duration_length: single entry valid 3 months, or multiple entry valid 1 year

sources.title: Government of Saint Lucia -- Apply for Saint Lucia Non-Immigrant Visa: 2 photos, 6-month passport validity, return ticket, itinerary, accommodation proof, EC$125 (single entry/3mo) or EC$190 (multiple entry/1yr), 5 working days processing via the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Visa Office

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Lucia's initial build. Visa administration sits with the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force (Visa Office) rather than a separate immigration department -- reflected in the source citation. This route applies to visa-required nationalities; many Commonwealth, EU, and other nationalities are visa-exempt for shorter stays per Saint Lucia's visa policy, not separately fetched for this build.
